scope: Theorem 4.1 (Padded partitions) of the manuscript “L1 Embeddings of Graphs of Bounded Treewidth” (preprints/L1-Embeddings-of-Graphs-of-Bounded-Treewidth-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13276d0ab77859c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are constants α ∈ (0, 1/8] and π ∈ (0, 1] such that, for every metric as above and every r > 0, there is a random partition P of V satisfying diam(C) ≤ r (C ∈ P), P [ Bd(x, αr) ⊆ P(x) ] ≥ π (x ∈ V ). Here P(x) denotes the part containing x.
